title: Upgrade notes: what to run now and what can wait

content.summary: Update toss-bin on every machine with **ralph up** before you add its allow rule. An old toss-bin ignores the temp-only flag and trashes any path.

items: Run **ralph up** on every machine, so toss-bin has the temp-only flag.
On each machine, run the **gate**. It must print BLOCKED and exit 1.
After the gate passes on every machine, add the **allow rule** to the Claude settings template.
Run ralph up again, then run the two **verify** lines.

blocks.text: **Do not add the allow rule first.** A toss-bin from before this change ignores the temp-only flag as unknown and trashes any path, without safe mode. The version flag cannot tell old from new: both print 1.3.1.

# 1. on every machine
ralph up

# 2. the gate: must print BLOCKED: and exit 1 (an old binary prints OK:)
toss-bin --temp-only --validate ~/notes.txt

# 3. add to permissions.allow in the consuming repo's Claude settings template:
#    Bash(toss-bin --temp-only *)

# 4. after the second ralph up
command -v toss-bin                       # ~/.local/bin/toss-bin
toss-bin --temp-only --validate /tmp/x    # OK: /tmp/x

This is the newest entry, [PR #415](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/415). With the rule in place, an agent can trash anything under `/tmp`, `/var/tmp` or `~/.tmp` with no prompt. It stays recoverable from `~/.Trash/my-trash/`.

sections.h: Six of the 22 entries ask for the same moondb import

cols.label: ask for one forced import
cols.sub: more than half of the moondb entries

blocks.text: Run the forced import after ralph up has brought in the newest moondb, with **no Claude Code session active**. A forced import closes in-flight turns. A run on an older build must be repeated: the entry for [PR #395](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/395) says so.
The import fills five things for sessions recorded before each change. Sessions older than 30 days need a wider since value.

items: **Model calls** a turn lost to a queued prompt or to the 4 MiB cap ([#394](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/394), [#395](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/395)).
**The last message** a parent sent a subagent before its edit ([#347](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/347)).
**The cwd repo and entrypoint** of a session ([#320](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/320)).
**Subagent cost** for the last month's sessions ([#298](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/298)).

sections.h: Five checks show whether an older entry still needs you

blocks.text: Each of these five entries breaks something until its action is done. Run the check with the same number: a clean result means the entry is behind you.

items: **brain**: brain doctor exits 0. If not, set the legacy indexes aside ([#401](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/401)).
**belt hints**: the grep prints nothing. If not, a hook errors on every csl search and every prompt ([#344](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/344)).
**keeper-of-facts**: belt doctor shows no unknown-hint warning. If it does, it exits 1 ([#332](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/332)).
**Homebrew tap**: brew tap does not list the tap. If it does, reinstall each tool through mise ([#351](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/351)).
**csl JSON**: the jq line prints a number. An older script must read the matches key ([#342](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/342)).

blocks.text:
# 1. exits 0, and index-dir names ~/.local/state/brain/index
brain doctor

# 2. prints nothing
grep -E 'belt hint (search|prompt)' ~/.claude/settings.json ~/.codex/hooks.json

# 3. no kof probe, no unknown-hint warning
belt doctor

# 4. does not list mad01/tap
brew tap

# 5. prints a number
csl search <q> --json | jq '.matches | length'

sections.h: Five items can wait, because skipping them breaks nothing

items: **Codex capture** in moondb is opt-in. Nothing changes until Codex runs the hooks ([#408](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/408)).
**The read-size matcher** for csl_read. A machine that skips it keeps the Read half of the hint, and belt doctor only warns ([#363](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/363)).
**The csl launcher** for csl_ask. A machine that skips it keeps a working csl server, and search works as before ([#359](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/359)).
**The brain legacy directories.** Delete the two once brain doctor passes ([#401](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/401)).
**The keeper-of-facts store and logs.** Nothing reads them now, and deleting them is your call ([#332](https://github.com/mad01/thismoon/pull/332)).

sections.h: Next: check the version after ralph up

blocks.text: When the first ralph up finishes, ask the service for its version and compare it with the merged commit. ralph can report ok while an **old binary** keeps running.
